Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone PNG illustration for the TechRef category interface. Landscape 1536x1024 composition. An ultra minimal, refined monochrome point-cloud sculpture in a completely PURE BLACK #000000 infinite void. The subject is made entirely of tiny white and silver light particles and very fine filament traces, with translucent gaps and crisp softly luminous contours. Controlled white bloom only, no colored light. Sophisticated scientific/editorial 3D aesthetic, calm and precisely formed, not explosive. Subject takes about 62% of image width and 58% of height, centered, generous absolutely black empty margins on all four sides; sparse particles very close to subject, completely fade before image edges. Background must be perfectly flat pure black, no gray haze, no gradients, no room, no floor, no reflection, no stars spread across frame. No text, no logo, no brand, no UI, no border, no watermark. Generic conceptual category illustration, NOT a depiction of a named commercial model.
Subject: a wide low horizontal graphics accelerator sculpture in three-quarter perspective, just a slim elongated rounded slab with two delicate circular vortex-fan openings indicated by precise particles. Architectural and abstract, recognizable as the GPU category. A few tiny particles elegantly dissolve at the far right edge.
